### What I aim to accomplish

What I aim to accomplish with this blog is to share any tech projects that I am working on currently, or will work on in the future. By posting these projects, I aim to share any knowledge or experiences that may be beneficial to anyone who may stumble their way onto my website.

Along with sharing any experiences, I hope to construct this blog to ultimately help showcase my projects to employers as I am studying towards a degree in Aerospace Engineering.
